custom_components.name: SplineHero
custom_components.description: Full-screen hero with Spline iframe background and overlay text.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' and 'framer-motion'. Configure Tailwind with the provided dark theme palette.
2. FONTS: Import 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css.

3. HERO: Implement the Spline iframe as a fixed background. Ensure the text content (H1, CTA) is in a relative container with z-index to sit ON TOP of the iframe. Add a gradient overlay at the bottom of the hero to blend into the next section.
4. SECTIONS: Build 'Services' using a Bento Grid. Build 'Process' as a vertical list with connecting lines. Build 'Contact' with a minimalist form and a prominent WhatsApp button.
5. ANIMATION: Use framer-motion for scroll reveal animations (fade-up) on all sections. Add hover effects to cards (border glow).
6. FOOTER: Minimalist footer with large 'Think Fast' typography.
7. CRITICAL: Do not use white backgrounds. Keep everything dark (#050505 or #0A0A0A). Use the violet accent sparingly for buttons and key highlights.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
